files.purpose: Moved BLoC/application source from packages/nextone_core into root lib/application.

Moved models package API responses and DTOs into root lib/data/models.
Moved models package mappers and adjusted generated mapper imports for their new location.
Moved repository interfaces and implementations from packages/nextone_core into root lib/data/repositories.
Moved service interfaces and implementations from packages/nextone_core into root lib/data/services.

Removed local path dependencies on nextone_core/models and merged their required dependencies into the root app.
Updated app bootstrap import to use the consolidated root package export.
Updated provider imports to resolve from the consolidated root package.
Updated presentation-layer imports from package:nextone_core and package:models to package:nextone.
Adjusted the default smoke test import/class reference so analysis stays error-free after consolidation.

code: Consolidated Dart source from packages/nextone_core and packages/models into root lib/, added a root package export at lib/nextone.dart, updated imports to package:nextone or direct package:nextone/... internal paths where needed to avoid self-export cycles, merged package dependencies into root pubspec.yaml, updated root app/presentation imports, and removed the obsolete packages/ directory.
assumptions: Generated Freezed and AutoMappr files should remain in place during ST-001; only import/path corrections needed for the move were applied.
Existing folder names such as dto/artist_dto and repository/service subfolders were preserved to minimize structural risk and avoid behavior changes in this step.
A minimal widget test import/class fix is acceptable within ST-001 because it is required for import consistency and analyzer cleanliness after consolidation.
notes: No product logic or widget behavior was intentionally changed.
Internal migrated files now use direct package:nextone/... imports where necessary to avoid circular self-export issues from the new umbrella export.
No import statements referencing package:nextone_core or package:models remain under lib/ or test/.
